content.comment_body: Hello everyone, I have a straightforward issue regarding diagram organization. My diagram is quite large and I would like to tidy it up. I want to use a flag, like M2, at multiple points without having the connections displayed everywhere, as it quickly becomes cluttered. However, when I choose a flag, I can't select the same one again for another spot. Hope my question is understandable, looking forward to your feedback.

You can only assign a specific address, such as M2, to a flag block once in your diagram. If you need to reference the status of this flag in several places, you’ll have to create graphical connections. These lines can be trimmed to reduce clutter.

analysis.insight_summary: The user experiences challenges in organizing and maintaining clarity in complex diagrams due to restrictions on flag reuse and the visual mess created by connection lines. These limitations make it difficult to achieve a clean and readable diagram, impacting the overall modeling process.
analysis.user_expectations: The user wishes to reuse the same flag across several locations in the diagram without having to display all connecting lines, thereby keeping the workspace clean and well-organized.
